correctness.rationale: The exact compressed monomial shift sends low r monomials to high r monomials, and the rank-n projection picks n even high coordinates. Solving the finite kernel equations gives a free r-dimensional graph with x0=0. The quotient map L is explicitly surjective with kernel exactly M. Under S* its image has 2n+1 disjoint independent output coordinates from distinct free graph variables; quotient dimension therefore exactly 2n+1 for all n>=1. The universal bound is separately reconstructed by a codimension-one model-space constraint and two rank-n comparisons. Exact rational matrix verification n=1,...,10 checks but does not replace the parameter-uniform proof.

value.rationale: The new exact extremizer resolves the natural sharpness question raised by the 2n+1 upper bound for arbitrary finite-rank perturbations of truncated Toeplitz operators. Positivity/selfadjointness/idempotence of the rank-n perturbation and a single monomial symbol are strong natural restrictions. Equality at every n proves neither the coefficient 2 nor the additive 1 can be improved uniformly even under these restrictions, identifying the true worst-case behavior of the defect invariant. The result does not claim a classification or a minimum model dimension.
